meta.name: render-stopmotion-hand-swatch-cycle
meta.description: Assemble a stop-motion hand-swatch-cycle product-demo ad from a config — a sequence of still PLATES (one hand swiping a single-barrel cosmetic across a cream skin-patch, the barrel + swatch changing per plate while the hand, background, crop, and lighting stay locked) is PNG→mp4 loop-encoded at each plate's own stop-motion hold (fast motion frames 150–250ms, per-shade ~380ms, hero beats 1100–1800ms), concat-demuxed with HARD cuts into a silent master, closed on a Playwright HTML-rendered branded end card (serif tagline + sans subtitle + real logo SVG over a hero BG, never AI-rendered text), and muxed with a pre-sourced music track playing under the end card with a fade tail (no VO). This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (loop-encode + concat-demux + end-card render + music mux); the master-anchor plate, shade plates, and end-card BG come from create-image-gpt-image-fal and the track from create-music-elevenlabs. Use for the stopmotion-hand-swatch-cycle format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品色板图片自动组装成定格动画广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量生成产品色板展示的定格动画广告视频。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble product swatch images into a stop-motion ad video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch produce stop-motion ad videos for product swatch displays.

howto.what: 这个技能会自动把一系列静态图片（手部涂抹化妆品、色号逐张变化）合成为一段无声的定格动画广告视频，并加上品牌结尾卡片和背景音乐。
howto.when: 当你准备好所有色号的静态图片、品牌Logo SVG、背景音乐，并希望将它们组装成一段产品演示定格动画时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这些色号图片合成一段手部涂抹的定格动画广告。
say.note: 技能会按顺序将图片转为视频片段并拼接。

say.text: 给这段定格动画加上品牌结尾卡片和背景音乐。
say.note: 技能会渲染结尾卡片并混入音乐。

howto.what_en: This skill automatically assembles a sequence of still images (hand swiping cosmetic, shade changing per plate) into a silent stop-motion ad video, appends a branded end card, and muxes background music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have all shade plates, brand logo SVG, and music track ready, and want to assemble them into a stop-motion product demo ad.

say_en.text: Assemble these shade images into a hand-swiping stop-motion ad.
say_en.note: The skill will loop-encode and concatenate the plates.

say_en.text: Add a branded end card and background music to this stop-motion video.
say_en.note: The skill renders the end card and muxes the music.
